_comment: The Game Studio child adapter candidate the joined suites and the guard mirror are bound to (VR-01). Path of the live Studio runtime on this machine; the SHA-256 is the accepted candidate's hash (October 25, 2026: native Mac launch). Until that adapter is activated the live file hashes differently and the joined suites FAIL instead of silently testing the wrong adapter; FAMILY_STUDIO_ADAPTER(_SHA256) names the isolated candidate for verification.
